message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R125]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is too short and feels like half a game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This should be ongoing at least with new levels and storylines added every week or so. It really felt like half a game, and that is the only reason I’m rating 3 stars, everything about it is phenomenal otherwise."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R126]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports erratic controls make timed levels impossible and frustrating.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls are a bit annoying, its hard to get the pieces in the right place and position; I didn’t mind it, until timed levels start to show. So, in those levels, the erratically behavior of the controls make these timed levels imposible and frustrating … and on the Apple TV is even worst."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R127]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A child reports the game is too hard and wants it to be easier.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "😡😡😡😡 This game is so hard!!!!!! I want it to be easier!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R128]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is cute, fun, and challenging with adorable animations.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I absolutely adore this game. The adorable animation when you complete a level as well as the somewhat challenging puzzle aspect makes this game great. I honestly have nothing to dislike about this game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R129]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has wonky controls and unclear direction but can be overcome.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Sometimes the controls and LEGO brick placement get a bit wonky or the direction in which you’re supposed to go unclear, but it isn’t anything that cannot be overcome."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R130]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports low resolution, off‑color palette, and choppy frame rate on M1 iPad Pro.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Low resolution, off color pallet and choppy frame rate for even the M1 ipad pro. No thanks"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R131]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports near‑impossible controls that cause them to delete the game.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Like others, it is near impossible to control where the piece should be placed. It just keeps dropping to the point where I just closed the game and deleted it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R132]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has no directions for how to play or place pieces.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game has absolutely no directions. There is nothing to say how to play it or how to place the pieces. Basic directions would be used."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R133]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has bad balance with boring puzzles and annoying controls.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Nice concept, excellent art, but very boring puzzle, very annoying control."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R134]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports sloppy phone controls that are trash and annoying.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I tried to enjoy this game but the touch controls on a phone are trash and very annoying."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R135]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports long‑press confirm fails due to finger location mismatch, making controls hard.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The way to control the puzzle to confirm location and the character move is way too hard. I know long press indicate confirm, but it keep fail to confirm because my finger location seems to differ than their desired location and then they just keep failing."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R136]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports frustrating controls that make accurate piece movement difficult, especially in timed puzzles.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I don’t know if game play experience would be better on a controller but as fun of a puzzle as it is, the control over where the pieces go is frustrating. Timed puzzles make it even more frustrating."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R137]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports beautiful design, immersive soundtrack, emotional plot, and satisfying sound design.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The soundtrack. It’s very immersive and uses a somewhat lofi upright piano which immerses the player. Also very nice and emotional chord progressions, as an art student I wish I would do stuff like this for indie games or something. The plot. I almost cried by the end of the game cause it was really touching to see the boy and his journey. I also loved the dog and his little chirps that he would make."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R138]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is relaxing, has great graphics, and uses satisfying hand‑placement sounds.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The Game just gives me the vibes it feels super good"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R139]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports cute visuals and music but unbearably bad controls that prevent young children from playing.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The puzzle game is cute and the music and visuals are really nice. But the controls are unbearably bad. It’s very difficult to snap in pieces. I also cannot imagine a child as young as for being able to play this by themselves much less having interest in playing this."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R140]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is relaxing, fun, and satisfying but wants more levels.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Relaxing and fun and satisfying little puzzles. Please add more levels!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R141]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game feels super good and relaxing.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The Game just gives me the vibes it feels super good"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R142]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports horrendous controls that defeat the purpose of a relaxing experience.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Downloaded this for a relaxing, zen-like gaming experience. The controls are horrendous. Inability to rotate the scene or zoom in and out for closer looks also a deal breaker."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R143]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is short and beat in a few days.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Beat it in a few days."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R144]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the story made them cry and they love the game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This story made me cry it is so emotional 😭 I love it best Apple Arcade game 🕹"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R145]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is creative and fun, reminding them of “Playdeads Inside”.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Very creative and fun. I enjoyed playing this. Got sick on a few levels but eventually figured it out. Reminded me of “Playdeads Inside” in a way."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R146]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is beautiful but too short and wishes for more.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Beautiful, but too short. I was just really getting in to it, when it was all over. MORE PLEASE!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R147]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the experience was simply beautiful, engaging, fun, and heartwarming.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "There’s not much more I can say than the experience was just beautiful. It was engaging, fun, and heartwarming. Absolutely loved it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R148]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is hard to control.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Stupid This game is hard controlling"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R149]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports getting stuck because a single wrong move traps them and they cannot progress.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I love the game and is fun but infiltrator the final part is bag because I make one wrong move and I cannot do anything and I try to reinstall the game but is still the same is still stuck because I make a wrong move can you fix I cannot do anything 😔"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R150]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is confusing and they deleted it after a car ride.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game is very confusing I got because I was going on a car ride and I needed to be entertained but the interdiction was very confusing so I deleted the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R151]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is beautiful and shows character development if you pay attention.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game is beautiful! It’s amazing to see the character development over time, if you pay attention"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R152]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is beautifully crafted but too easy and too short.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Beautifully crafted, but too easy and too short. This was fun while it lasted but I kept hoping for things to get more challenging, and suddenly the game was at its end."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R153]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the tutorial and controls are hard to understand and would not recommend for easily angered people.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I downloaded this game about a week ago and immediately knew I had to write a review. I actually first downloaded this game on my TV, and it was really hard to control, but I thought that was just because I don’t have a game controller and it was really hard to do any games with the TV remote. I decided to download it on my mobile device, so I did. The tutorial was very hard to understand and control, but I thought that was just because I was new to the game. So I dealt with it for a little while longer, but then the characters were introduced and it wasn’t getting any easier to control. In fact, it was a lot harder. So, overall, good concept, hard to control, wouldn’t recommend for people who are easily angered especially."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R155]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports being stuck on level twelve for months and cannot win.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "IMPOSSIBLE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! The first time I played this game I thought it was great but now I’ve been stuck on level twelve for MONTHS!!!! There are no golden one stud long pieces at ALL!!!!!! You literally CANNOT WIN!!!!! Thumbs down."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R157]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game refuses to play and lacks a help menu.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Game refuses to play & no help menu. Lovely visuals but no way to access help when game stops playing. Not only do levels 3 & up remain hidden, but so does any help menu."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R158]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports inadequate controls that rush the player and are super awkward for placing blocks.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Cute game with inadequate controls that rush you. Game is cute. First few levels were fun. Then you have to rush to place and the controls don’t allow for that. You have to press and hold off the main area, which is super awkward, to place a block. It’s very frustrating doing this with moving blocks."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R161]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports being stuck and asks for help solving a specific puzzle.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I don’t know how to solve the part where the guy is trying to get to the guy at the waterfall. Please help me! Tell me the solution."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R162]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports poor controls ruin what could be a great game, citing camera snapping and grabbing wrong bricks.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Poor controls ruin what could be an otherwise great game. I love the concept. Artistic style is perfect for Lego. Music is great. Puzzles seem like they would be a lot of fun. Unfortunately, it is all RUINED by horrible controls. The camera snaps around for no good reason. You try to grab a brick but end up grabbing the one next to it which usually messes up whatever you were trying to do in the first place."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R163]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is super fun but wishes it was longer.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "super fun, wish it it was longer. add more levels please"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R164]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the building system takes too long and suggests adding buttons.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Insanely frustrating. I try to place the legos but the building system takes so long! There should be buttons wouldn’t recommend"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R166]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports beautiful visuals but clunky controls that lead to boredom after a few levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Beautiful But Boring. I love Lego so I was really excited to try this game. It looks amazing. The color palette is great and overall the game is visually stunning. The gameplay is thwarted by clunky controls and after a few levels, I was done with this game forever."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R167]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is loved and wishes for more content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "MORE, MORE, MOREEEE. i love this game, i wish there was more in it"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R168]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is fun, loves Lego, completed it, and wants more levels.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game is really fun and I love legos, and I actually did complete the game. I would recommend this for people that like/love legos, I would like more levels though, because when I completed the game, I was really sad because there weren’t anymore levels, so please add more levels to this game. I support the devs of the game and LOVE this game. Other then not having more levels, Overall this game is really fun and and I loved it"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R169]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is loved but far too short and wants more levels.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Love it. I love this game but it is far too short. Please release more levels."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R170]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is a good puzzle with odd controls that become easy after learning, and suggests easier menu access.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "It’s a good game for people who like to figure things out. There aren’t many instructions, but I kinda enjoyed just experimenting and figuring it out. I found the controls odd at first, but they’re really easy to use once you get the hang of it, especially after I realized I can hold and item in the air if I just don’t hold down on it. I would love more levels, but I don’t know if that’s gonna happen. If it does, the only thing I would recommend is making the menu and the restart button easier to find. Right now you tap in the top right corner area to bring it up, but I only figured that out when I was changing my brightness."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R171]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is the best ever played but is stuck on a quiz that never ends.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Best game ever played but one problem. Get this game but when I’m doing the quiz the 2nd one when is it going to end?????When!!!???!!!???"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R172]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports wonky controls, inability to rotate view, and pieces jumping to wrong positions.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I really wanted to love this game but honestly it’s just hard to play. The controls are wonky & pieces are hard to get to go into place. You cant rotate the view in order to see what you would think you need to see. And anytime I try to move a piece the character jumps to that piece."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R173]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is wonderful and full of joy and charm.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Wonderful. Its just so full of joy and charm. There’s a lot here. Play it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R174]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports very poor controls that cause frustration after a minute of play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Very poor controls. I wanted to like this game but as soon as I started playing I realized how hard it is to actually play. I’ll try to move a piece and it’ll just place it before I get it where I want. I can only play for about a minute before getting too frustrated"
    }
  ]
}
